The General Real Estate Authority launched a new e-service on Sunday that allows residential lease contracts to be documented within 15 minutes.

The authority said the service covers more than 1,200 brokerage offices across 13 regions, with a documentation fee of 125 riyals per contract.

It added that the platform has documented 48,500 contracts since its pilot launch, with a satisfaction rate of 92.4 percent.
